answer: Behavioral overlap clustering. After each epoch, score every pair of identities by similarity across independent task histories, timing of quill submissions, and shared counterparties. Flag dense subgraphs whose internal similarity far exceeds a random-pair baseline. Identities in a flagged component are rate-limited and their rewards frozen pending review; a single relic of organic history breaks the cluster. Attackers must sustain costly distinct voyages across many accounts for months, since one genuine diverse trajectory per identity multiplies their operating cost roughly tenfold.
